title: fix(ui): connect styled controls to field labels
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Styled Input and Textarea controls now connect to their field labels, helper or error descriptions, and invalid state while preserving caller-provided ARIA attributes and existing asChild wrappers. Clicking labels can focus the corresponding Playground and Websim text controls. Playground’s two Dimensions inputs now sit in a group named by the visible Dimensions text instead of sharing a single field ID; redundant Language and Length ARIA labels were removed, and the Dimensions row retains its responsive alignment. FieldStack now documents its one-text-control-per-field convention. @pollinations/ui was bumped from 0.1.0-alpha.13 to 0.1.0-alpha.14, with accessibility regression tests added.
